mentions.name: Mac time tracking desktop app
mentions.description: A Mac desktop app that tracks time by monitoring the title bar and time spent in each application. It can be used entirely for free, with the option to sync tracked time back to HeyGopher to match it with active projects.
mentions.source_excerpt:
There's a desktop app tracking the title bar and time you spend in each app. 
- You can use this 100% free, or sync this back to https://heygopher.ai to match the time up with your active projects.
